title: Episode 190: Ingrid Spencer-Executive Director at AIA Austin
description:
Episode 190 features a great conversation with Ingrid Spencer, the Executive Director at AIA Austin, the Austin Chapter of the American Institute of Architects. Ingrid shares the AIA Austin local initiatives and involvement with the community including the Homes Tour. Learn more at https://aiaaustin.org/ and https://designaustin.org/

Podcast music by www.bensound.com

title: Episode 189: Jon Roberts
description:
This episode features a great conversation with Jon Roberts, Managing Partner at TIP Strategies. Jon is also the author of The Cost of Cool: Austin's Tech Growth and the People Left Behind. Jon talks about his background and his interesting new book.

Learn more about Jon and his new book here: https://tipstrategies.com/the-cost-of-cool/

Podcast music by www.bensound.com

title: Episode 187: Joel Kocher, CEO of Humann
description:
Episode 187 features an insightful conversation with Joel Kocher, CEO of Humann. Joel talks about his entrepreneurial journey from being an executive at Dell Computers to founding Humann. He discusses the IP that was licensed from the University of Texas to launch Humann and how important cardiovascular health is and why he is so passionate about it. Learn more at https://humann.com/

Podcast music by www.bensound.com

title: Episode 128: Mike Jarmuz, General Partner at Lightning Ventures
description:
Episode 128 features a fun conversation with Mike Jarmuz, General Partner at Lightning Ventures.  Lightning Ventures invests in Bitcoin native startup companies.  You can learn more at https://ltng.ventures

title: Episode 41: Mayor Steve Adler
description:
Episode 41 features an informative conversation with Austin Mayor Steve Adler.  Mayor Adler talks about his career before being elected Mayor, how the City and the economy in Austin are dealing with the pandemic, and the future of business in our great City.
